draft.text: You came because you have been having worse headaches over the past few weeks.
You also have high blood pressure readings, even though you are taking lisinopril.
We did not do any tests or check your blood pressure during this visit.
You said you only check your blood pressure once a week and that it does not change much throughout the day.
Your headaches and high blood pressure may be related to not taking your medication consistently.
You said you forget to take lisinopril on weekends.
You will be reminded to take lisinopril regularly and to check your blood pressure more often.
You will need to come back for a follow-up to see how you are doing and to review any test results.

unverified_summary.text: You came because you have been having worse headaches over the past few weeks.
They are strong and happen all day, but get better with Tylenol.
You also mentioned that your blood pressure has been high, with readings like 160/87 and 175/92 in the last three weeks.
We did not do any tests or check your body during this visit.
Your headaches and high blood pressure may be linked to not taking your lisinopril medicine on weekends.
You said you sometimes forget to take your medicine, which could cause your blood pressure to change.
You will need to see a doctor for a physical checkup and some blood tests.
These tests will check your blood pressure, blood count, kidney function, and hormones.
You will also be asked to take your lisinopril regularly and track your blood pressure.
We will talk about the test results and how you are feeling at your next visit.
